title: Hyatt Announces Plans for the A Hyatt Regency Hotel on Australia's Gold Coast
summary: CHICAGO (NOVEMBER 26, 2026) – Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H) today announced the signing of an agreement with Sunnyland Investment Development Group (SIDG) for the development of Hyatt...
body_markdown:
**CHICAGO (NOVEMBER** **26** **, 2026)** – Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H) today announced the signing of an agreement with Sunnyland Investment Development Group (SIDG) for the development of Hyatt Regency Gold Coast. Slated to open in 2030, the hotel will debut within Orlo, a landmark waterfront mixed-use development in Surfers Paradise, further strengthening Hyatt’s presence in Australia and expanding the Hyatt Regency brand’s footprint in the Gold Coast, one of Australia’s most vibrant tourism destinations.


Situated at 2 River Terrace in the heart of Surfers Paradise, Hyatt Regency Gold Coast will offer easy access to the Gold Coast’s renowned attractions, including golden beaches, surf clubs, oceanfront dining, boutique shopping and nightlife. Set on the banks of the Nerang River, it will offer a peaceful setting with views that stretch across the river and hinterland on one side, and vistas of the ocean and iconic Gold Coast skyline on the other.


With a current portfolio of more than 245 hotels across over 50 countries, spanning both urban and resort destinations, the Hyatt Regency brand is renowned for creating inviting, energizing environments that seamlessly unite work, wellness, relaxation and connection. Hyatt Regency Gold Coast will offer guests an open invitation to explore the region, build deep connections with the place and the ones their traveling with and the opportunity to learn what’s possible through travel.


“We are delighted to be collaborating with SIDG on plans to bring the Hyatt Regency brand to the Gold Coast,” said Sarah Leow, Head of Growth & Owner Relations, North East Asia & South East Asia, Hyatt. “As part of Hyatt’s strategic expansion of its brands into this dynamic destination, Hyatt Regency Gold Coast will be well positioned to meet the growing demand for premium accommodation with its distinctive hospitality offering, creating spaces and experiences that bring people together.”


“We are proud to join forces with Hyatt to bring the Hyatt Regency brand to the Gold Coast,” said Tony Liu, General Manager of SIDG. “Hyatt Regency Gold Coast will bring internationally recognized hospitality to Orlo, complementing our vision for high-quality residential living and exceptional lifestyle amenities. Together, we are creating a distinctive mixed-use destination that we believe will contribute to the continued evolution of the Gold Coast.”


**Designed in Rhythm with the River and Ocean**


The hotel’s prime site between the river and the ocean serves as the springboard for the design vision by leading Australian architects DKO. The building’s curved architecture is inspired by the path of water that flows from the river’s source before immersing in the vast expanse of the Pacific Ocean. Inside, a harmonious palette of nature-inspired hues and natural materials such as timber and stone will foster an environment of calm, elevated by the breathtaking views.


The hotel’s accommodation and amenities will unfold across floors six to 14 of the building. They include 176 guestrooms, an outdoor pool and bar, all-day dining and a fully equipped gym, as well as wellness facilities, including treatment rooms, an ice bath and recovery lounge.


Hyatt Regency Gold Coast will form the hospitality component of the wider Orlo mixed-use development, which will also include Orlo Residences. Residents will have the opportunity to join a special hotel membership program, offering access to select premium amenities at Hyatt Regency Gold Coast, including selected dining, wellness and lifestyle experiences. Hyatt Regency Gold Coast will be at the heart of the Orlo development, inspiring community amongst guests and residents alike.


*The term “Hyatt” is used in this release for convenience to refer to Hyatt Hotels Corporation and/or one or more of its affiliates.*


**About Hyatt Regency**


The Hyatt Regency brand is a global collection of hotels and resorts found in more than 245 locations in over 50 countries around the world. The depth and breadth of this diverse portfolio, from expansive resorts to urban city centers, is a testament to the brand’s evolutionary spirit. For more than 50 years, the Hyatt Regency brand has championed fresh perspectives and enriching experiences, while its forward-thinking philosophy provides guests with inviting spaces that bring people together and foster a spirit of community. As a hospitality original, Hyatt Regency hotels and resorts are founded on openness—our colleagues consistently serve with open minds and open hearts to deliver unforgettable celebrations, effortless relaxation and notable culinary experiences alongside expert meetings and technology-enabled collaboration. The brand prides itself on an everlasting reputation for insightful care—one that welcomes all people across all countries and cultures, generation after generation. For more information, please visit[hyattregency.com](http://www.hyattregency.com/) . Follow @HyattRegency on[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/HyattRegency/?fref=ts) and[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/hyattregency/?hl=en) , and tag photos with #HyattRegency.


**About Hyatt Hotels Corporation**


Hyatt Hotels Corporation, headquartered in Chicago, is a leading global hospitality company guided by its purpose – to care for people so they can be their best. As of September 30, 2026, the Company's portfolio included more than 1,500 hotels and all-inclusive properties in 84 countries across six continents. The Company's offering includes brands in the *Luxury Portfolio* , including ***Park Hyatt*** ®, ***Alila*** ®, ***Miraval*** ®, ***Impression by Secrets*** , and ***The Unbound Collection by Hyatt*** ®; the *Lifestyle Portfolio* , including ***Andaz*** ®, ***Thompson Hotels*** ®, ***The Standard*** ®, ***Dream*** ® ***Hotels*** , ***The StandardX*** ®, ***Breathless Resorts & Spas*** ®, ***JdV by Hyatt*** ®, ***Bunkhouse*** ® ***Hotels*** , and ***Me and All Hotels*** ; the *Inclusive Collection* , including ***Zoëtry*** ® ***Wellness & Spa Resorts*** , ***Hyatt Ziva*** ®, ***Hyatt Zilara*** ®, ***Secrets*** ® ***Resorts & Spas*** , ***Dreams*** ® ***Resorts & Spas*** , ***Hyatt Vivid*** ® ***Hotels & Resorts*** , ***Bahia Principe Hotels & Resorts, Alua Hotels & Resorts*** ®, and ***Sunscape*** ® ***Resorts & Spas*** *;* the *Classics Portfolio* , including ***Grand Hyatt*** ®, ***Hyatt Regency*** ®, ***Destination by Hyatt*** ®, ***Hyatt Centric*** ®, ***Hyatt Vacation Club*** ®, and ***Hyatt*** ®; and the *Essentials Portfolio* , including ***Caption by Hyatt*** ®, **Unscripted by Hyatt** ®, ***Hyatt Place*** ®, ***Hyatt House*** ®, ***Hyatt Studios*** ®, **Hyatt Select** ® **,** and ***UrCove*** . Subsidiaries of the Company operate the World of Hyatt® loyalty program, ALG Vacations®, Mr & Mrs Smith®, Unlimited Vacation Club®, Amstar® DMC destination management services, and Trisept Solutions® technology services. For more information, please visit *www.hyatt.com* .


**About SIDG**


SIDG is an international property development company with a track record of delivering first-class developments without compromising on quality. We specialise in large-scale land developments and residential and commercial developments. Founded in 2010, we have delivered projects that exceed 1.6 million sqm across Australia and internationally. Entrepreneurial in our approach, our investment in time and resources enables us to be strategic in our acquisition. Today, we have developed and held assets with over 400,000 Sqm GFA globally.
